section: Five Year Plans I to XII - objectives, targets, achievements and failures of each
subsections: Eleventh and Twelfth Plan vision - inclusive growth, monitorable targets
Second Plan - pruning of outlay, criticism of the Nehru-Mahalanobis strategy

accepted.s: The Community Development Programme was introduced during which Five Year Plan?
accepted.x: The Community Development Programme was introduced in 1952 during the First Five Year Plan.
accepted.tq: Directly link the programme with its introducing plan.

accepted.s: Which one of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Bank nationalisation of 14 banks — Fourth Plan
Drought Prone Area Programme — Fifth Plan
accepted.x: Bank nationalisation involving 14 banks was undertaken during the Fourth Plan. The Drought Prone Area Programme, Minimum Needs Programme and Twenty-Point Programme belong to the Fourth, Fifth and Fifth Plans respectively.
accepted.tq: Start from the sure programme–plan pair and eliminate swapped plans.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The Drought Prone Area Programme was introduced during the Fourth Plan.
2. The Minimum Needs Programme was introduced during the Fifth Plan.
3. The Twenty-Point Programme was introduced during the Sixth Plan.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. The Twenty-Point Programme was introduced during the Fifth Plan, making statement 3 false.
accepted.tq: Find the statement containing the plan swap.

accepted.s: The first population policy and the Tribal Sub-Plan are associated with which Five Year Plan?
accepted.x: The first population policy was introduced in 1976 and the Tribal Sub-Plan was associated with the Fifth Plan.
accepted.tq: Use the common plan association for two linked policy initiatives.

accepted.s: Which of the following pairs is NOT correctly matched?
accepted.x: NREP was introduced in 1980 during the Sixth Plan, but the pair is not correctly matched as stated because NREP belongs to the Sixth Plan; the other three pairs are also correctly matched. Therefore, this question as framed has no unique incorrect pair.
accepted.tq: Check every programme against its plan before selecting the exception.

accepted.s: The Women's Component Plan and the seven Basic Minimum Services were associated with the:
accepted.x: The Women's Component Plan and seven Basic Minimum Services were associated with the Ninth Plan.
accepted.tq: Discriminate between closely succeeding plan periods.

accepted.s: Which one of the following is correctly matched?
accepted.x: Command Area Development was introduced in 1974–75 during the Fifth Plan. IRDP and NABARD belong to the Sixth Plan, while the Women's Component Plan belongs to the Ninth Plan.
accepted.tq: Use the year–plan relationship to identify the correct pair.

accepted.s: The Integrated Rural Development Programme, after the merger of TRYSEM, NREP and other schemes, is associated with which plan?
accepted.x: IRDP, including the merger of TRYSEM, NREP and other schemes, was associated with the Sixth Plan during 1978–80.
accepted.tq: Identify the plan from the programme’s restructuring period.

accepted.s: Which Five Year Plan was the first to focus on gender issues and inter-State as well as intra-State inequalities?
accepted.x: The Sixth Plan was the first plan to focus on gender issues and inter-State and intra-State inequalities.
accepted.tq: Directly test the distinctive feature of a plan.

accepted.s:
Consider the following pairs:
a. First Plan — Agriculture and irrigation
b. Second Plan — Heavy industry
c. Sixth Plan — Power
 d. Seventh Plan — Employment
Which of the pairs given above are correctly matched?
accepted.x: All four pairs are correctly matched. Agriculture and irrigation dominated the First Plan, heavy industry the Second, power became significant in the Sixth, and employment was the thrust of the Seventh Plan.
accepted.tq: Match each plan with its distinctive focus sector.

accepted.s: Human development was the core of which Five Year Plan, which also shifted emphasis from heavy industry towards infrastructure?
accepted.x: The Eighth Plan placed human development at the core and shifted emphasis from heavy industry to infrastructure.
accepted.tq: Use the combined focus and structural shift as identifying clues.

accepted.s: Which one of the following statements regarding the Eighth Plan is correct?
o: It assigned the highest priority to bank nationalisation.
Its main focus was exclusively heavy industry.
Its public outlay was financed mainly by deficit financing.
It made power the sole focus of public expenditure.
accepted.x: The Eighth Plan’s public outlay was financed mainly by deficit financing, while its developmental emphasis moved towards human development and infrastructure.
accepted.tq: Choose the precise positive statement and reject absolute distractors.

accepted.s: In the Tenth Plan, agriculture was described as the:
accepted.x: The Tenth Plan made agriculture the prime moving force of the economy.
accepted.tq: Test the exact wording used for the plan’s sectoral priority.

accepted.s: Which sector was placed first in the Eleventh Plan, with education receiving the highest emphasis?
accepted.x: The Eleventh Plan placed the social sector first, with education at the top of its priorities.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the plan’s social-sector priority from industrial priorities.

accepted.s: Which of the following was NOT a component of the Eleventh Plan’s inclusive-growth strategy?
o: Complete withdrawal of the private sector
Access to health, education and skills
accepted.x: The Eleventh Plan envisaged continued reform and a competitive private sector; it did not propose its complete withdrawal. The other three were components of inclusive growth.
accepted.tq: Reject the extreme statement that reverses the stated strategy.
accepted.sec: Eleventh and Twelfth Plan vision - inclusive growth, monitorable targets  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
The Eleventh Plan’s inclusive-growth strategy included which of the following?
1. Infrastructure thrust
2. Good governance
3. Continued reform and a competitive private sector
4. Attention to disadvantaged groups
Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: All four were components of the Eleventh Plan’s inclusive-growth strategy. The strategy combined infrastructure, governance, private-sector reform and support for disadvantaged groups.
accepted.tq: Recognise the comprehensive strategy option when all listed components are valid.
accepted.sec: Eleventh and Twelfth Plan vision - inclusive growth, monitorable targets  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The investment requirement under the Eleventh Plan was estimated at 37 per cent of GDP, rising to what level by the end of the Plan?
accepted.x: The Eleventh Plan required investment equivalent to 37 per cent of GDP, rising to 39 per cent by the end of the Plan.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the initial requirement from the end-of-plan figure.
accepted.sec: Eleventh and Twelfth Plan vision - inclusive growth, monitorable targets  [APPSC]

accepted.s: How many national monitorable targets and State-level targets were set under the Eleventh Plan?
accepted.x: The Eleventh Plan set 27 national monitorable targets, including 13 targets at the State level.
accepted.tq: Separate the national count from the State-level subset.
accepted.sec: Eleventh and Twelfth Plan vision - inclusive growth, monitorable targets  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly states the Eleventh Plan’s monitorable targets?
o: GDP growth 9%, agricultural growth 4%, IMR 28 and TFR 2.1
GDP growth 9%, agricultural growth 6%, IMR 30 and TFR 2.1
GDP growth 10%, agricultural growth 4%, IMR 20 and TFR 1.9
GDP growth 8%, agricultural growth 5%, IMR 25 and TFR 2.5
accepted.x: The Eleventh Plan targeted 9 per cent GDP growth, 4 per cent agricultural growth, an IMR of 28 and a TFR of 2.1. Its MMR target was 1 per 1,000 live births.
accepted.tq: Split the option into several figures and verify each one.
accepted.sec: Eleventh and Twelfth Plan vision - inclusive growth, monitorable targets  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly compares the Eleventh and Twelfth Plans?
o: Eleventh: balanced regional growth; Twelfth: complete self-reliance
Eleventh: inclusive growth only; Twelfth: poverty elimination only
Eleventh: faster and more inclusive growth; Twelfth: faster, sustainable and more inclusive growth
Eleventh: sustainable growth only; Twelfth: industrial growth only
accepted.x: The Eleventh Plan was titled “Towards Faster and More Inclusive Growth”, while the Twelfth Plan emphasised “Faster, Sustainable and More Inclusive Growth”.
accepted.tq: Compare the exact themes rather than relying on broad similarities.
accepted.sec: Eleventh and Twelfth Plan vision - inclusive growth, monitorable targets  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Which of the following was a broad objective of the Twelfth Plan?
1. Reduction of poverty
2. Reduction of regional inequality across and within States
3. Welfare of SCs, STs, OBCs and minorities
4. Creation of employment for youth
Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: All four were broad objectives of the Twelfth Plan. It also sought to promote sustainable and inclusive growth.
accepted.tq: Identify the option containing the complete set of social objectives.
accepted.sec: Eleventh and Twelfth Plan vision - inclusive growth, monitorable targets  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Under the Twelfth Plan, spending on health, education and skills was increased by how many percentage points of GDP?
accepted.x: The Twelfth Plan raised spending on health, education and skills by 1.2 percentage points of GDP.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the social-sector increase from the infrastructure increase.
accepted.sec: Eleventh and Twelfth Plan vision - inclusive growth, monitorable targets  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Which of the following measures was associated with the Twelfth Plan?
1. Reduction in the number of Centrally Sponsored Schemes
2. Provision of a flexi-fund
3. Promotion of public-private partnerships in the social sector
4. Review of the plan/non-plan distinction by the Rangarajan Committee
Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: All four measures were associated with the Twelfth Plan. The Plan also increased allocations for health, education and skills and for infrastructure.
accepted.tq: Check whether each administrative reform belongs to the same plan package.
accepted.sec: Eleventh and Twelfth Plan vision - inclusive growth, monitorable targets  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The planned public outlay for the Second Plan was Rs 4,800 crore. What was the actual outlay?
accepted.x: The planned public outlay was Rs 4,800 crore, while actual public outlay was Rs 4,600 crore.
accepted.tq: Distinguish planned outlay from actual outlay.
accepted.sec: Second Plan - pruning of outlay, criticism of the Nehru-Mahalanobis strategy  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The actual public outlay of Rs 4,600 crore during the Second Plan consisted of investment expenditure and current expenditure of:
o: Rs 3,800 crore and Rs 800 crore respectively
Rs 3,650 crore and Rs 950 crore respectively
Rs 4,000 crore and Rs 600 crore respectively
Rs 3,100 crore and Rs 1,500 crore respectively
accepted.x: Actual outlay comprised Rs 3,650 crore of investment expenditure and Rs 950 crore of current spending.
accepted.tq: Use the component figures and verify that they add to the total.
accepted.sec: Second Plan - pruning of outlay, criticism of the Nehru-Mahalanobis strategy  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following was NOT a reason for pruning the Second Plan’s outlay?
o: A sustained fall in inflation caused by excess food production
accepted.x: The outlay was pruned because of food and capital shortages, inflation, unrealistic closed-economy assumptions and the 1957–58 foreign-exchange crisis. A sustained fall in inflation was not a reason.
accepted.tq: Find the option that reverses the stated economic conditions.
accepted.sec: Second Plan - pruning of outlay, criticism of the Nehru-Mahalanobis strategy  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following was a major criticism of the Nehru–Mahalanobis strategy?
o: It neglected agriculture and contributed to food shortages and inflation.
It relied excessively on labour-intensive small industries and created too many jobs.
It gave no importance to heavy industry.
accepted.x: The strategy was criticised for neglecting agriculture, generating food shortages and inflation, and relying on capital-intensive heavy industry that created few jobs.
accepted.tq: Identify the criticism that combines the sectoral and macroeconomic effects.
accepted.sec: Second Plan - pruning of outlay, criticism of the Nehru-Mahalanobis strategy  [APPSC]

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about the Mahalanobis model:
1. It assumed a relatively closed economy.
2. It gave priority to capital-intensive heavy industry.
3. It generated substantial employment in the short run.
4. It was associated with food shortages and inflation.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: Statements 1, 2 and 4 are correct. Capital-intensive heavy industry was criticised for creating relatively few jobs, so statement 3 is false.
accepted.tq: Locate the employment statement that contradicts the capital-intensive strategy.
accepted.sec: Second Plan - pruning of outlay, criticism of the Nehru-Mahalanobis strategy  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The Tenth Plan model projected growth of 8.1 per cent, whereas the actual growth during the Plan years lay in the range of:
accepted.x: The Tenth Plan model projection was 8.1 per cent, while actual growth during the Plan years ranged from 6.2 to 8.6 per cent.
accepted.tq: Compare the projected figure with the actual range.
accepted.sec: Second Plan - pruning of outlay, criticism of the Nehru-Mahalanobis strategy  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which of the following is an example of duplication during plan implementation?
o: Separate population policies for every district
Parallel Five Year Plans for each ministry
accepted.x: Duplication in implementation was illustrated by overlapping rural electrification schemes.
accepted.tq: Apply the concept of duplication to the concrete example.
accepted.sec: Second Plan - pruning of outlay, criticism of the Nehru-Mahalanobis strategy  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly states the Eighth Plan’s performance against its targets?
o: Public-sector outlay share was 39% against a target of 37%, and employment growth was 4% against 2.6%.
Public-sector outlay share was 45.2% against a target of 34.3%, and employment growth was 2.6% against 2%.
Public-sector outlay share was 25% against a target of 34.3%, and employment growth was 1% against 2%.
Public-sector outlay share was 34.3% against a target of 45.2%, and employment growth was 2% against 2.6%.
accepted.x: The Eighth Plan achieved a public-sector share of 34.3 per cent against a target of 45.2 per cent, while employment growth was 2 per cent against the target of 2.6 per cent.
accepted.tq: Read actual and target figures in the correct direction.
accepted.sec: Second Plan - pruning of outlay, criticism of the Nehru-Mahalanobis strategy  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The Prakasam Barrage and Nagarjuna Sagar projects are associated respectively with which plan periods?
o: First to Second and First to Second
accepted.x: Prakasam Barrage, completed in 1957, and Nagarjuna Sagar are both associated with the First-to-Second Plan period.
accepted.tq: Match project chronology with the plan period rather than the completion year alone.

accepted.s: Which project was sanctioned during the Third Plan?
accepted.x: Srisailam was sanctioned in 1963 during the Third Plan.
accepted.tq: Use the project’s sanction year to identify the plan.

accepted.s: The foundation stone of Nagarjuna Sagar was laid by Jawaharlal Nehru on:
accepted.x: Jawaharlal Nehru laid the foundation stone of Nagarjuna Sagar on 10 December 1955.
accepted.tq: Test the exact date and associated national leader.

accepted.s: Telugu Ganga is associated with which Five Year Plan?
accepted.x: The Telugu Ganga project, associated with 1983, was launched during the Sixth Plan.
accepted.tq: Link the project year with the corresponding plan period.
